_comment: Drift that is already known and already recorded elsewhere, so that exit 1
from the schema checker means NEW drift rather than old news (DATA-1).
This list is a debt register, not a silencer. Every entry says why it is
here and where the decision lives. An entry whose drift is fixed becomes a
'stale' finding and must be deleted - the checker reports those too, so the
list cannot quietly become a second document that lies about the schema.
